mcp_tools.name: forecast_confidence_scoreboard
mcp_tools.title: Confidence scoreboard
mcp_tools.description: Submits a forecast-confidence scoreboard record (a ledger of resolved binary probabilistic forecasts by named forecasters, per-forecaster scoreboard rows, calibration reporting, ranking and honesty in use) and returns a deterministic CONFIDENCE_SCOREBOARD_SOUND / CONFIDENCE_SCOREBOARD_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including recomputed per-forecaster Brier score, hit rate and calibration-gap checks, with per-check evidence. Scores the declared ledger; it makes no forecast.

inputSchema.description: The forecast-confidence scoreboard manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

subject.description: Scoreboard subject (the forecaster population / forecast programme).

scoreboard.description: Declared scoreboard: {forecaster, forecasts_count, mean_stated_probability, hit_rate, calibration_gap, brier_score, rank}.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Alice: prob 0.8 outcome 1 mean 0.8 hit 1.0 gap 0.2 Brier (0.8-1)^2=0.04. Bob: prob 0.4 outcome 1 mean 0.4 hit 1.0 gap 0.6 Brier (0.4-1)^2=0.36. Overall mean (0.8+0.4)/2=0.6, hit 1.0, gap 0.4, Brier (0.04+0.36)/2=0.2, direction underconfident (0.6<1.0), worst Bob (gap 0.6). Rank 1=Alice (lower Brier), 2=Bob.
